bull_case_summary: MR D.I.Y. generated RM462.958m after specified capex, lease and interest costs, supporting cash-backed recovery at 17.71x earnings. Round two accepts overdistribution and shows a mechanical inventory-release sensitivity still leaves RM338.918m, without calling it a recurring forecast.
bear_case_summary: The bear accepts surviving recovery resources but stresses RM511.784m dividends exceed even unadjusted surplus and quarterly margin fell to 10.69%. Lease-inclusive net debt of RM1.411bn means cost normalisation and cash retention matter to the reported 5.32% yield.
key_points_of_agreement: Positive cash remains after conservative adjustments.
Current dividends are not fully covered by the specified cash bridge.
key_points_of_disagreement: Whether cash-positive recovery sufficiently compensates margin pressure and the payout shortfall.
unresolved_uncertainties: Actual cost normalisation and payout restraint.
Repeatable cash conversion without inventory release.
